shadow.$description: Two layers live here. The Soft-Lift Rule still governs product surfaces: one soft shadow per theme, plus an avatar hairline. The sm/md/lg/xl elevation ladder exists for consumers that need graded depth; dark.* is its dark-theme counterpart, because faint black shadows are invisible on near-black surfaces.

soft-lift-dark.$description: The single dark-theme shadow — floats cards, tiles, toast.

inset-hairline.$description: 1px inner ring on avatars so light player colors keep their edge.

none.$description: No shadow — the flattened surface used by cognitive-accessibility mode.

sm.$description: Elevation 1 — resting cards on a light surface.

dark.$description: Dark-theme elevation ladder. Higher-opacity black with larger blur restores depth cues that 0.05–0.1 alpha shadows cannot provide on near-black surfaces.
